tools.name: adopt
tools.description: Copy findings from a local bundle into the target PR bundle and re-anchor them. Call after a local review to post it on a PR. Writes the target bundle's findings store.

from.description: Local bundle slug to adopt findings from.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: calibrate
tools.description: Join stored findings against live thread and file state, or grade the offline probe. Call after posting to measure precision. Reads GitHub live; the probe rewrites kb-grades.jsonl.

judgeFile.description: Path to a judge spec file (probe mode).

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

probe.description: Grade the offline probe instead of joining live state.

tools.name: check-tree
tools.description: Gate on a clean git worktree, allowing the paths in expect. Call before finalizing when stray edits must fail the review. Reads git only; writes nothing.

expect.description: Comma-separated allowlist of paths that may be dirty.

tools.name: config
tools.description: Explain the stored effective policy of a fetched run, or preview a proposed configuration file with current settings and environment. Call before acting on policy to see values, requirements, plan, and spend. Reads the run bundle only; writes nothing and never approves.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Preflight the configured code host's CLI and auth, git, and storage. Call first when a verb fails for environmental reasons; provider picks the host (default github). Reads local tools and config; writes nothing.

provider.description: Code host to preflight (github, gitlab, gitcafe, forgejo, bitbucket, azure); default github.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a PR into .verdict/state/<pr> (diff, metadata, threads, prompt input). Call first for any PR review; an over-cap diff refuses, so re-run with chunk=true. Writes the bundle and calls the PR's host.

index.description: Explicit index hand-off: a ref or a directory holding an index store. The fetch verb writes impact.json and a capped ## impact section on toc.txt; omitted means no impact section.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: fetch-local
tools.description: Fetch a local git diff into .verdict/state/local-<name>. Call to review uncommitted or branch changes without a PR. Writes the bundle; no network.

index.description: Explicit index hand-off: a ref or a directory holding an index store. The fetch verb writes impact.json and a capped ## impact section on toc.txt; omitted means no impact section.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: fix
tools.description: Run one bounded, verify-gated fix pass over an inline finding or a batch scope (all, selected, or recipe). It writes the fix ledger and hands the verify command to the agent, capped per sig. Set test to a reproduced sig to promote its artifact to .verdict/tests; commit commits only that file.

all.description: Batch every open inline finding at or above the severity floor.

commit.description: Commit the promoted regression test alone as test: regression for <sig>; requires test.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

recipe.description: Batch the open inline findings whose stored lens matches the named recipe's lens set.

selected.description: Batch only the sigs a GitHub fetch recorded in selected.json as reacted to by a human.

test.description: Promote one reproduced finding's retained artifact to .verdict/tests/<sig>-<hash>.<ext>.

tools.name: handoff
tools.description: Project the open inline findings a fix run would take as one handoff. Carries sig, locator, severity, rigor, fix text, KB rules, the recorded verify command, and the exact brief fix prints. Reads the bundle; writes nothing.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: index
tools.description: Query the local code index under .verdict/index for callers, candidate tests, co-change partners, CODEOWNERS owners, blast radius, or stored trees. Call before editing code to find callers and the tests to read. Reads the index and git objects only; never builds or prunes (those are CLI-only) and writes nothing.

at.description: Tree or ref to query; default HEAD.

commits.description: Co-change window size in commits (1-100000; default 2000).

depth.description: Import hops to walk for transitive candidate tests (1-8; default 3; 1 turns the walk off).

from.description: Checkout directory to read the index from; default the repository root.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (1-200; default 50 for callers and tests-for, 20 for co-changed).

minCount.description: Minimum co-change count a partner needs (1-100000; default 2).

path.description: Repository path for tests-for, co-changed, or owners.

paths.description: Repository paths for blast-radius: every declaration in each file is a changed symbol; no bundle or host call.

pr.description: Fetched PR bundle whose full.diff names blast-radius's changed paths and lines; its tree is queried when the index holds it, otherwise HEAD with a warning.

query.description: Subcommand: callers, status, tests-for, co-changed, owners, or blast-radius; build and prune are CLI-only.

since.description: Co-change window start: a duration (90d, 12w, 18mo, 2y) or a commit ref.

symbol.description: Caller query symbol (bare Target or package-qualified app.Target), or the tests-for --symbol input.

tools.name: ingest
tools.description: Import OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 results from any static analyzer into the target bundle's findings store (from: sarif). Call after a scanner run to merge results with review findings; results the pinned diff cannot anchor come back in skipped[]. Writes findings.json; no network.

from.description: Source format to import; sarif is the one this build reads.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

sarif.description: Path to the SARIF 2.1.0 report file to import. Read offline, capped at 8 MiB.

tools.name: init
tools.description: Scaffold .verdict control files from a style preset. Call once in a new repository; yes=true overwrites existing controls. Writes controls and runs a tree check.

tools.name: journal
tools.description: Read a bundle's append-only invocation journal (steps, unfinished calls, and content-digest chain breaks). Call to audit what ran against a bundle. Reads the external state journal only; writes nothing.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: learn
tools.description: Read or update the local knowledge base. Call to list rules or add, retire, restore, propose, accept, or reject one, or to attach a revert/incident to a recorded bundle with incident + sha + path. Proposals are inactive until accepted. Supports dry_run for the proposal lifecycle.

at.description: RFC 3339 detection time; defaults to the current UTC time.

dry_run.description: Report what would change without writing.

incident.description: Recorded bundle a later revert or incident is attached to (the vendored chain: fetch + post or record first).

note.description: Evidence note for the attach (at most 2000 bytes; control characters are stripped).

path.description: Repo-relative paths the revert or incident touched; at least one, deduped and sorted.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

sha.description: Merge commit the revert or incident is traced back to (7-40 lowercase hex digits).

status.description: List rules with counters, precision, exposure and acceptance (boolean list switch; learn sets no status).

url.description: Evidence link for the attach (http or https only).

tools.name: next
tools.description: Return the top actionable finding. Call after fetch to pick the next review or fix target. Reads the bundle; writes nothing.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

status.description: Status filter for the top finding (all, open, addressed, wont-fix, false-positive, deferred); empty means open.

tools.name: pack
tools.description: List lens packs: built-in, org (personal settings packs[]), and repo (.verdict/packs/), in precedence order, with lens/rule ids and drift. Lists the packs in this checkout; a review reads repo packs from the PR's base, so a pack the PR adds or edits is listed here but not used. Reads local files; writes nothing.

tools.name: post
tools.description: Post exactly one review to GitHub, GitLab, or Forgejo, or preview with dryRun. Call once after review.json is final; never write a review note. A secret-shaped value refuses post-secret-shaped (allowSecretValues publishes it). Writes post.json; GitLab posts a bound request-changes as a comment, recorded in withheld[].

allowSecretValues.description: Publish review text that carries a secret-shaped value; the post-secret-shaped refusal names this override.

dryRun.description: Report what would change without writing.

force.description: Override the refusal that would otherwise block the change.

provenance.description: Expose the bundle provenance receipt as data.receipt and data.truncated plus the Inputs footer line; a bundle without one warns and degrades to an empty receipt.

summary.description: PR-level summary comment mode: comment (create or update in place) or off (default).

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: pr_wait
tools.description: Bounded foreground PR wait. No local writes. Timeout defaults to 50s and cannot exceed 50s. Use instead of sleep loops.

interval.description: Initial poll interval, at least 1s and at most timeout; defaults to 1s.

once.description: Observe once without sleeping; an unmet condition returns condition-unmet data.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

provider.description: Host override; defaults to saved provider or github. A host outside the enum refuses explicitly.

until.description: Condition to await; review-changed compares with this call's first observation.

tools.name: query-bundles
tools.description: List every bundle under the served root with its counts and head. Call to see which bundles exist before querying findings. Reads local bundles only; writes nothing.

pattern.description: Bundle glob filter (portable relative glob); empty lists every bundle.

tools.name: query-copy
tools.description: Return one finding's copy prompt and its runnable triage command on the dashboard query layer. Call to copy a prompt for an agent. Reads local bundles only; writes nothing.

bundle.description: Bundle slug under the served root (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: query-cost
tools.description: Roll up review spend cost by repo, week, or model on the dashboard query layer. Call for cost summaries and trends. Reads local bundles only; writes nothing.

by.description: Spend grouping (repo, week, or model); empty defaults to model.

tools.name: query-finding
tools.description: Read one full finding with its fix by signature on the dashboard query layer. Call with a sig from query-findings. Reads local bundles only; writes nothing.

bundle.description: Bundle slug under the served root (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: query-findings
tools.description: List one bundle's ranked findings with evidence rungs on the dashboard query layer. Call after listing bundles to inspect open findings. Reads local bundles only; writes nothing.

bundle.description: Bundle slug under the served root (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: query-health
tools.description: Report the dashboard query layer's version, served roots, and bundle counts. Call to check what this server serves. Reads local state only; writes nothing.

tools.name: ready
tools.description: Report merge readiness (checks, threads, draft, conflict) or gate on it. Call before merging. Reads github and gitlab live; writes nothing.

check.description: Gate tier (critical, important, informational); empty disables the gate.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

timeout.description: Build wait duration, 1s–50s; defaults to 50s when wait_for is build.

wait_for.description: Wait for build completion before reporting readiness; timeout returns not-ready data.

tools.name: record
tools.description: Validate review.json and merge it into the findings and record stores. Call for local bundles that cannot post; writes findings.json and record.json. Set dry_run to repeat every check without writing, fix each problem, and after 3 rounds report any that remain instead of recording.

dry_run.description: Report what would change without writing.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: report
tools.description: Render the offline review report (ranked findings, counts, markdown/SARIF). Call after fetch or record; the follow-up is next. Reads the bundle, appends a journal entry, and writes any artifacts you request.

category.description: Finding category filter; empty disables the filter.

compare.description: Baseline bundle to compare against (a bundle directory, or a PR/local slug in the same state directory): groups signature-matched findings into new, persisting, resolved, not reviewed.

output.description: Write the rendered report markdown to this path.

provenance.description: Expose the bundle provenance receipt as data.receipt and data.truncated plus the Inputs footer line; a bundle without one warns and degrades to an empty receipt.

risk.description: Include the advisory risk score (claimed level or unknown, deterministic store floor, and reported = max(claimed, floor)).

sarif.description: Write a SARIF report to this path.

status.description: Status filter (all, open, addressed, wont-fix, false-positive, deferred).

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: risk
tools.description: Rank the bundles under .verdict/state into an advisory triage queue. Reads local bundles only and writes nothing. Follow with gate --max-risk to gate one bundle.

limit.description: Rows to publish, 1–200; defaults to 50. The tallies keep describing the whole queue.

status.description: Bundle filter: open (host-open and local, the default) or all (adds merged and closed).

tools.name: show
tools.description: Return one full finding by signature or unique prefix. Call to inspect a finding named by report or next. Reads the bundle; writes nothing.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: threads
tools.description: Refresh the normalized review-thread feed (.verdict/state/<pr>/threads.json) from the host, or with resolve close verdict-authored threads. Call after pushing fixes to re-read resolution state before a re-review or merge readiness. Reads the host; writes threads.json and, on resolve, threads-resolve.json.

dryRun.description: Report what would change without writing.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: trend
tools.description: Roll up review outcomes across fetched bundles. Call for a cross-PR summary; set incidents to measure the miss rate over attached incidents. Reads local bundles; writes nothing.

incidents.description: Measure the miss rate over attached incidents: reads .verdict/incidents.jsonl and each bundle's findings store.

tools.name: triage
tools.description: Operator-only: flip one finding's status with a rationale. Never call while reviewing a PR; propose triage[] in review.json instead. Writes findings.json and stages KB credit.

dryRun.description: Report what would change without writing.

force.description: Override the refusal that would otherwise block the change.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

status.description: Status to flip the finding to (open, addressed, wont-fix, false-positive, deferred).

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Run the recorded verifyCmd under the watchdog and record the proof. Pass group and command together to validate one deep plan group at the reviewed root, or set sandbox true for enforced isolation — bubblewrap on Linux, sandbox-exec on macOS. Never fabricates a patch or a command from configuration.

command.description: Deep validation: explicit command to run at the reviewed root. Requires group.

envAllowlist.description: Additional parent environment variable names to pass through to the verification child process, overriding default-deny filtering and secret-name dropping.

group.description: Deep validation: stable plan group id from run.json. Requires command.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

sandbox.description: Run under an enforced sandbox — bwrap on Linux (no network, hidden credential dirs, a writable repo, a private /tmp), sandbox-exec on macOS (no network, loopback included; no Mach services; writes only to the repo and a private TMPDIR; credential paths and shared host temp roots denied); refuses sandbox-unavailable when the host cannot enforce it or the root's shape cannot be protected (Linux: no .git; a symlinked .git; a .git that is neither a directory nor a gitdir: file; a gitdir or commondir that does not resolve; a gitdir that is the root itself; an unreadable or non-regular pointer file; or a pointer whose walk passes through a symlink or a missing component inside the root).

sandboxNetworkOnly.description: Linux-only fallback for hosts without bwrap: unshare --user --map-root-user --net, network isolation alone with no mount, filesystem, or PID isolation (credential paths, /tmp, the host /proc, and unix sockets stay reachable; never recorded as sandboxed); mutually exclusive with sandbox and refused as sandbox-unavailable on other hosts.
